Offline: py -3 tools/hair_groom/mv_ratio.py <burst dir>; with the camera moving, the camera-only share is not meaningful (the background moves), the hair / ring median |mv| ratio is: predicted 0.8-1.2 (strands move with their head, as the cards do: hs1 cards 0.52-1.08); the static-camera strand failure was 0-0.54 (hs1, before 5y). No frame watchdog trip expected (report only: not gated in c).
observables.d_distance: static isometric camera, distant detail off / 1/4 / 1/8 / off, a PNG trace (dump_preview_f32=1) 1.5 s after each switch (the 30-frame level vote plus the camera BLAS build: ~1.2 s at 30 fps), then a 120-frame cost window. pl1 211046: 5 of 13 grooms at level 2 (1/4) and level 3 (1/8), heads 6-53 px; no holes, no card fallback, no outline growth in any on shot; float frame mean within the off/off spread (0.4%).
observables.e_cost: every window: '[hair primary] strand G-buffer draws GPU', 'rt passes: GPU cost' and '[pace] rendered frame time' per 60 frames. pl1: strand G-buffer off 0.28-0.31 ms, 1/4 0.21-0.22, 1/8 0.19; rt passes and frame time: report only (FG on, unfocused; judge GPU ms, not frame time, if the window is occluded).

pixel_lod_lines.win-q: '[hair groom] pixel LOD (last 60 frames)': groom frames at level 1 or 2 non-zero, 'small keep 0.250'
pixel_lod_lines.win-e: the same grooms one level deeper, 'small keep 0.125'

energy: float frame mean of the four shots (dump_preview_f32) within the off/off spread; the off shots bracket the on shots.
invalid_if: any of the four motion-trace lines missing
no header safety line in lower or watch
background median |mv| under 0.05 px in the orbit burst (the camera did not move: the rotation input was lost)
decision: pass: 0 trips in b, ring ratio 0.8-1.2 in c, no holes or outline growth in d with the strand G-buffer cost at or below off. Then the presets may flip hair_distant_detail to 1/4 (docs/progress/claude-hair-detail-knob.md) and the new keys join the RTX Hair On bundle.
